card.name: Small linking words in essay prose
card.fires_on: Common small words such as the, their, been, is, of, are, and, he inside long sentences of essay or philosophical prose. The marked word sits mid-clause, where a noun or verb is expected next.

modes.label: Articles and pronouns
modes.description: A determiner or pronoun such as the, their or he that opens a noun phrase in the middle of a clause.
modes.example: the totem is the mystical soul of<< the>> group, the clan, or the race

modes.label: Verbs and conjunctions
modes.description: Auxiliary verbs or and/of that link parts of an abstract statement.
modes.example: action and reaction are equal<< and>> opposite.

card.writes: The promoted tokens (util, calc, via, dint) hint at a weak push toward words like utilize or calculate, with computing words suppressed.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in the middle of abstract, essay-style sentences, not on any medical content.
